published_fmt_audit.theorem_3: For each fixed interval, the survivor asymptotic holds with probability 1-o(1); no numerical decay rate or common cutoff is printed.
published_fmt_audit.theorem_4: For a fixed hypergraph input it constructs random covering edges with residual asymptotics holding with probability 1-o(1), uniformly in the listed finite set parameters but without a numerical rate.
published_fmt_audit.theorem_5: The first-stage residue vector a is good with probability 1-o(1), and Theorem 4 is applied conditionally on each good value of a.
published_fmt_audit.section_6: The first-stage a_s are independent uniform residues and independent of preliminary tilde-n_p; the final n_p are jointly conditionally independent given a under formula (6.17).
hidden_rate_nodes: Lemma 6.4 Markov-Chebyshev o(1) and implied constants

actual_joint_law.outer_variable: A=(a_s mod s) over the small-prime set S
actual_joint_law.inner_variable: N-prime=(n-prime_p) output by the conditional hypergraph covering law for the fixed outer A
actual_joint_law.preliminary_tilde_n_role: defines the conditional edge probabilities; it is not by itself the final large-prime residue vector
actual_joint_law.correction_to_predecessor: The candidate omega must encode the joint or sequential pair (A,N-prime), not A alone.
